Requirement: The satellite launch mass, computed as the total dry mass of all units plus a 20% system margin, shall not exceed 150 kg.
The payload (optical camera and mass memory) shall consume less than 70 W in imaging mode.
The AOCS shall provide an attitude knowledge accuracy better than 10 arcsec, using at least two star trackers for redundancy.
The camera shall have a ground sampling distance of at most 5 m from an altitude of 600 km.
The camera mass shall not exceed 40 kg, as allocated by REQ-SYS-001.

The mass memory shall store at least 512 Gbit of images.
Capacity | end of life.
The images shall be downlinked within a "responsive" time (target TBD).
